notes: Draft configuration: Open single-lap sprint follows Startline Straight, Woodside, the eastern loop and Shenstone Straight to the finish. The operator course plan identifies the 831 m single-lap route; the independent source-node selection measures 827.9 m. The catalogue scalar 983 m and diagram include untimed approach/run-on areas. Those areas and the alternate Flagpole connector are excluded from the timed draft; both endpoint nodes agree with private start and finish gates. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 827.9 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 36 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. This standing-start run begins at the first paired edge station and ends at the last; original timing metadata are retained. Finish speed is unconstrained, with no stopping zone modelled. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
